qAndA.question: What color was used for the fill of the "State" dropdown box?

qAndA.answer: He changed the "Format Category" to "Number" and set "Decimal Places" to zero in the field properties.
qAndA.question: How did the narrator ensure that only numbers could be entered in the "Postcode" field?

qAndA.answer: To obtain explicit consent from the user regarding the agreement terms and to ensure their awareness of the conditions.
qAndA.question: What was the purpose of adding the checkbox next to "I agree to the conditions described on page 1."?

qAndA.answer: The narrator held down the Alt key while typing the first letter of each state abbreviation.
qAndA.question: What keyboard shortcut was used to move the cursor to the right place after typing the state abbreviations in the dropdown list properties?

qAndA.answer: The narrator copied the existing "State" dropdown box and pasted it into the new section. He then deleted the original "State" box in the "Alternative Billing Address" section and renamed the pasted box to "State 2".
qAndA.question: How was the "State 2" dropdown box created in the "Alternative Billing Address" section?
